calculation_handling.description: The listed bicycle parking regulations do not prevent a building or structure for which a complete Section 45 minor variance application was filed on or prior to July 22, 2022.
calculation_handling.gaps: Minor variance application dates are not held.

calculation_handling.description: The listed bicycle parking regulations do not prevent a building or structure for which a complete Section 45 minor variance application was filed after July 22, 2022 in respect of a building permit referred to in 230.90.15.1(1).
calculation_handling.gaps: Minor variance application dates and the linked building permit are not held.

calculation_handling.description: The listed bicycle parking regulations do not prevent a building or structure for which a complete Section 45 minor variance application was filed after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Minor variance application dates are not held.

calculation_handling.description: The listed bicycle parking regulations do not prevent a building or structure for which a complete Section 45 minor variance application was filed after March 31, 2025 in respect of a building permit referred to in 230.90.15.1(2).
calculation_handling.gaps: Minor variance application dates and the linked building permit are not held.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a complete application for a minor variance as one meeting Section 2 of Ontario Regulation 200/96 under the Planning Act.
A minor variance applied for on or prior to July 22, 2022 may be granted in the context of the former Chapter 970 regulations or By-law 569-2013 as it read then.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A building permit for the project in (A) may be issued after final minor variance approval if it complies with the former Chapter 970 regulations or By-law 569-2013 as it read then.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A minor variance applied for after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025 may be granted in the context of former regulations 970.30.15.5(3), (4) and (5) or By-law 569-2013 as it read then.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A building permit for the project in (C) may be issued after final minor variance approval if it complies with former regulations 970.30.15.5(3), (4) and (5) or By-law 569-2013 as it read then.
calculation_handling.gaps: The former-rules path is never evaluated.

230.90.15.3(1).explanation: Current bicycle parking rules do not block a project with a complete Section 45 minor variance application filed on or before July 22, 2022, or filed after that date for a building permit covered by 230.90.15.1(1).

230.90.15.3(2).explanation: A narrower list of current bicycle parking rules does not block a project with a complete minor variance application filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, or filed later for a building permit covered by 230.90.15.1(2).

230.90.15.3(3).explanation: A complete application for a minor variance means one that satisfies Section 2 of Ontario Regulation 200/96 under the Planning Act.

230.90.15.3(4).explanation: For projects covered by these transition rules, a minor variance may be granted, and a building permit later issued, by reference to the earlier Chapter 970 bicycle parking rules or the by-law as it read on the relevant earlier date, depending on when the minor variance was applied for.
